scope: 65 previously filter-kept source/spec pairs; 47 trained; 18 length-excluded

amba_clock_gate_ctrl.reason: Only u_reset_sync crosses; surrounding wakeup/clock-gating controller is not a reset synchronizer primitive.

axi4_cdc_rd.reason: u_ar and u_r carry payloads in opposite directions through gaxi_fifo_async between s_aclk and m_aclk; dedicated CDC wrapper.

bridge_mon_cdc.reason: Packet FIFO crosses s_aclk to aclk; registered Gray timestamp and quasi-static cfg cross back through staged synchronizers.

ca_rx_align_fifo.reason: SYNC_FIFO=0 instantiates lane_clk/com_clk async payload and soft-reset FIFOs; default SYNC_FIFO=1 is explicitly synchronous, so CDC is configuration-dependent.

cdc_bit.reason: i_async_in shifts through SYNC_STAGES registers on i_clk; final-stage output, configured reset value.

cdc_counter.reason: Source count and Gray code register together; cdc_gray_sync transfers Gray bits into i_dst_clk before binary reconstruction.

cdc_fifo.reason: Independent i_wr_clk/i_rd_clk pointers are registered in Gray code, synchronized in opposite directions, and used for local full/empty decisions.

cdc_gray_sync.reason: One cdc_bit chain per registered Gray input bit on i_clk; spec requires single-bit Gray transitions.

cdc_handshake.reason: Req/ack CDC exists, but spec calls it four-phase while RTL uses a two-phase toggle handshake; freeze excludes contradictory mechanism contract.

cdc_open_loop.reason: Source holds data and stretched valid; destination synchronizes valid then captures data; spec states required hold duration and no acknowledgement.

cdc_pulse.reason: Named cdc_pulse top selects toggle transfer via cdc_bit or counter transfer via cdc_counter; both helper modules are present in source.sv.

cdc_pulse_sync.reason: Source pulse toggles toggle_src; two destination stages plus XOR with delayed sample regenerate events; spec requires pulse spacing.

cdc_qualifier.reason: i_valid crosses cdc_bit; o_valid enables destination bus capture; spec states held-data requirement and extra capture cycle.

cdc_reset.reason: Small 33-line asynchronous-assert, SYNC_STAGES-clock release chain; only clock/reset interface.

cdc_reset_sync.reason: Small reset chain exists, but spec says flops are asynchronously preset to 1 while RTL clears them to 0; contradictory reset behavior.

cdc_sync2.reason: Two destination flops synchronize data_src on clk_dst with rst_dst_n and RESET_VAL.

cdc_sync3.reason: Three destination flops synchronize data_src on clk_dst with rst_dst_n and RESET_VAL.

cdc_synchronizer.reason: Dedicated level synchronizer wrapper binds async_in to glitch_free_n_dff_arn on clk/rst_n; not an atomic bus handshake.

cdc_toggle_sync.reason: Two destination synchronizer stages plus XOR delayed sample detect both toggle transitions.

chi_link_rx.reason: i_req crosses u_req_sync before link ACK/grant logic; synchronization enabled by default, documented bypass for known synchronous configuration.

double_flop_synchronizer.reason: Enabled two-register level synchronizer on clk; parameter selects asynchronous or synchronous rst.

example_handshake.reason: Local dependency cdc_handshake has clk_src/clk_dst ports and two-flop REQ/ACK paths; differs from same-named standalone cdc_lib module.

example_pulse_sync.reason: Dedicated wrapper transfers irq_pulse from clk_cpu to clk_periph through local cdc_pulse_sync dependency.

example_reset_sync.reason: Small 46-line reset-only wrapper instantiates independent 2/3/2-stage release chains for clk_100m/clk_200m/clk_50m.

example_sync2.reason: flag_src crosses two destination stages on clk_200m; source clock/reset ports are declared context ports and unused in this wrapper.

example_sync3.reason: status_src crosses three destination stages on clk_500m; source clock/reset ports are declared context ports and unused in this wrapper.

example_toggle_sync.reason: rx_event_toggle crosses to clk_cpu and yields synchronized level plus both-edge event; MAC clock/reset ports are context ports.

gaxi_skid_buffer_async.reason: Write-domain skid buffer feeds dual-clock gaxi_fifo_async, binding separate write/read clocks and resets.

high_speed_in_bus.reason: Small handshake receiver synchronizes request through two flops before data_available/acknowledge logic.

high_speed_out_bus.reason: Small handshake sender synchronizes returning acknowledge, holds output data while request is outstanding, and counts accepted sends.

levelsync.reason: Two serial clk_dest flops sample src_data with rst_dest_n; optional simulation delay does not replace the synchronizer.

levelsync_sr.reason: Two serial clk_dest flops with asynchronous rst_dest_n and set_dest_n; both controls appear in exact interface and reset-over-set priority is documented.

mc_training_shell.reason: Compact shell has real mc_clk/dfi_clk sync_pulse paths for cal_expect/cal_valid and staged calibration data return; not reset-only.

mspi_intf.reason: Real spi_bitsync paths exist, but spec mislabels rst_n_sclk as a clock; full SPI command/shift engine also exceeds focused primitive/wrapper scope.

rst_regen_low.reason: Small 44-line reset-only wrapper drives levelsync data high, asynchronously clears on async_rst_n and releases rst_n after two clk edges.

spi_bitsync.reason: Dedicated two-stage clk/rst_n level synchronizer, with DWIDTH and reset value preserved.

spi_client.reason: Spec clock list omits SCK although RTL clocks serialization on both SCK edges; prose also refers to absent in_idle; full SPI client core.

spi_clock_barrier_crossing.reason: Spec promises payload transfer and returned acknowledgement absent from ports/RTL; write_new uses rising-edge detector, not both-edge toggle transfer.

spi_master.reason: Reset-only classification admitted a complete SPI/AVMM controller with CSR/buffer/interface children; not a small reset synchronizer.

spi_rstnsync.reason: Small 40-line reset primitive: async clear then first stage plus spi_bitsync release; scan_mode explicitly bypasses the chain.

sspi_avmm_intf.reason: Contains csr0_reg bit synchronizer but is a three-channel AVMM transaction/burst controller, not a focused CDC primitive or crossing wrapper.

sync_pulse.reason: Source toggle crosses SYNC_STAGES destination flops and XOR edge detector; spec explicitly states one-way operation and minimum spacing despite loose introductory handshake wording.

sync_signal.reason: RTL has a real N-stage pipeline, but spec Input ports invents signals; actual inputs are only clk and in.

traffic_counter.reason: Tap controls cross explicit two-stage cdc_synchronizer instances before local edge detection/counting; occupancy uses bitwise level sync, not atomic snapshot.

triple_flop_synchronizer.reason: Two-flop dependency plus third enabled destination register implements three serial stages with matching reset mode.

triple_flop_toggle_synchronizer.reason: Claimed toggle change detector is actually in_sync AND NOT in_delete; falling toggle transitions generate no event.

wide_double_flop_synchronizer.reason: One enabled two-flop chain per input bit; spec explicitly requires quasi-static data and disclaims atomic bus handshake.

andesite_training_plane.reason: Excluded from latest 47 and frozen v1: 8332 tokens exceeds unchanged 4096 limit. Memory-training controller with level and pulse CDC; interface matches, not reset-only.

apb4_slave_cdc.reason: Excluded from latest 47 and frozen v1: 4465 tokens exceeds unchanged 4096 limit. Command/response async FIFOs exist; spec reset list omits presetn.

apb4_slave_cdc_cg.reason: Excluded from latest 47 and frozen v1: 5473 tokens exceeds unchanged 4096 limit. Gated command/response async FIFOs exist; spec omits presetn and calls gating/idle status ports clocks.

apb5_slave_cdc.reason: Excluded from latest 47 and frozen v1: 6803 tokens exceeds unchanged 4096 limit. Command/response async FIFOs exist; spec reset list omits presetn.

asyncfifo.reason: Excluded from latest 47 and frozen v1: 4614 tokens exceeds unchanged 4096 limit. Gray-pointer FIFO exists; generated interface incorrectly includes function-local input gray as a module port.

axi4_cdc_wr.reason: Excluded from latest 47 and frozen v1: 4948 tokens exceeds unchanged 4096 limit. Dedicated AW/W/B async FIFOs between s_aclk/m_aclk; interface matches.

bridge_cdc_slave_arb.reason: Excluded from latest 47 and frozen v1: 8081 tokens exceeds unchanged 4096 limit. Per-lane async FIFOs and slave arbitration exist; interface matches; large bus arbiter.

cdc_counter_domain.reason: Excluded from latest 47 and frozen v1: 9418 tokens exceeds unchanged 4096 limit. Pulse/FIFO/handshake CDC paths exist; spec clock list incorrectly includes o_clk_ticks counter.

cxs_slave_cg.reason: Excluded from latest 47 and frozen v1: 5285 tokens exceeds unchanged 4096 limit. ACTIVEREQ level synchronizer exists before gated CXS receiver; interface matches.

mc_dfi_3p1_plane.reason: Excluded from latest 47 and frozen v1: 10650 tokens exceeds unchanged 4096 limit. DFI plane contains pulse/level crossings and mc_dfi_cdc FIFO wrapper; interface matches; serializer/aligner subsystem.

mc_dfi_cdc.reason: Excluded from latest 47 and frozen v1: 6849 tokens exceeds unchanged 4096 limit. Command/data/init token FIFOs cross ctl_clk/dfi_clk; interface matches.

ptp_clock_cdc.reason: Excluded from latest 47 and frozen v1: 9245 tokens exceeds unchanged 4096 limit. Timestamp held-bus/toggle CDC spans input/output/sample clocks; interface matches.

rtc_core.reason: Excluded from latest 47 and frozen v1: 29100 tokens exceeds unchanged 4096 limit. Reset, commit handshake and snapshot pulse crossings exist; large RTC/calendar/alarm core; prose uses pclk/presetn aliases while header uses clk/rst_n.

wb4_slave_cdc.reason: Excluded from latest 47 and frozen v1: 4342 tokens exceeds unchanged 4096 limit. Wishbone command/response async FIFOs cross wb_clk/aclk; interface matches.
